title: Sonya Akulshina — a scroll of stills and split frames with tiny labels
note: Below the cover the page is only footage: full-width clips, then frames split into two or four panels (a tree and a profile, a crossing from above and a park), with black letterbox gaps between. A single small caps label sits dead centre over each run ("SELECTED PERSONAL WORKS", "DEBUT SHORT FILM / HOW LONG UNTIL NOW?"), white on a black chip. Each clip is a looping muted Readymag video. Worth reusing: for film work, let the clips be the layout and keep text to centred captions.
